QuestInfo.name: Feather Plant
QuestInfo.0: Get some Feather Plants from #p1052001# in Kerning City. Even if you can't get everything, you should get at least a portion.
QuestInfo.1: The Dark Lord gives you some Feather Plants. He says the people from Ereve can help you get more. Report this to Claudine in the Underground Base.
QuestInfo.2: After all your hard work, you still didn't have enough Feather Plants. Claudine doesn't seem to want to work with the Cygnus Knights to get more. She said they broke a promise to help Edelstein in the past...
